caution_findings.context: DBAASP uses X in GNGVVTTISHECNMNSWQFLFXCCG where the primary source reports T22 dehydration/dehydrobutyrate; preserved as sequence_modified_not_normalized.
Romboutsia/Clostridium, NCIB/NCIMB, and abbreviated Bifidobacterium infantis target labels differ between database and primary table notation; values are preserved with source_conflict context.
Several DBAASP agar diffusion rows record target-only NA concentration; primary Table 1 categorical no-inhibition rows are used rather than inventing numeric halo values.
